objective: Measure whether an explicit, shp-checked Shape contract reduces (H1) constraint decay across L0->L3 and (H2) generational decay across successive regenerations, against baseline and a prose-rules control.

levels.L0: Express only, unconstrained internals, in-memory storage allowed.

conditions.baseline: Functional API plus structural constraints only.
conditions.prose: Baseline plus architectural boundary rules in plain English (confound control).
conditions.shape: Prose plus an shp-checked Shape DSL contract and, in the generational loop, shp feedback each generation.

evidence_status: The single-trial per-task numbers recorded in earlier revisions are SUPERSEDED: they predate rig validation, used an invalid (never shp-checked) Shape contract, had no prose control, did not separate rig from functional failures, and were n=1. Trustworthy results come from the rig-gated n>=5 run in runs/main/analysis.json, interpreted per docs/preregistration.md.
validation: bun run verify-rig must pass (golden references clean, mutant caught) before any agent-run result is believed. Each primary task has tasks/<id>/reference/ as a positive control.

primary_tasks.domain: Coupon budget and per-user limit accounting
